title: Fans bemused by 'awkward' Henry and Scott gaffe at Ballon d'Or

 Ballon d'Or: Fans bemused by 'awkward' Thierry Henry and Kate Scott gaffe
 One viewer said Frenchman was “behaving like a right plum” 
 Allow Exco Player content
 This content is provided by Exco Player and may use cookies or similar technologies. Please click 'Allow and Continue' below to load the content.
 Allow and Continue Arthur Ferridge , Sports Reporter @ ArthurFerridge 1 minute ago 
 COMMENTS Fans were left bemused after Thierry Henry was caught up in a number of awkward moments as he hosted the Ballon d’Or on Monday night.
 Harry Kane took centre stage as he became the first Englishman to win the Ballon d’Or since 2001 , but only after a lengthy, delayed ceremony.
 The legendary Arsenal striker Henry took on hosting duties alongside his CBS Sports colleague Kate Scott, but the pair’s usual chemistry was lacking as a handful of awkward moments overshadowed the usual suave event.
 The first came as Lamine Yamal joined Henry on stage to pick up the young player of the year award. Henry posed the Barcelona star a question in Spanish, which he did not appear to understand, creating an awkward exchange. 
 Fans branded Thierry Henry’s stilted banter ‘awkward’ AFP/Getty He then asked Yamal whether he would have preferred to win the Ballon d’Or rather than the Kope Trophy, which some fans deemed ‘unnecessary’.
 “Henry is so wrong for asking him that question,” one wrote.
 Henry later corrected Scott on her pronunciation of the Socrates Award, named after the late Brazilian footballer rather than the Greek philosopher, which she did not appear to appreciate.
 There were a number of other odd incidents, with various guests seemingly unable to hear Henry and Scott. That came on the heels of various other organisational gaffes, with the ceremony being delayed 45 minutes due to bad traffic. Three articles naming Kane, Kylian Mbappe and Lamine Yamal as winners of the Ballon d’Or were also erroneously published to the France Football website.
 “He’s an extreme pain to watch,” one fan wrote of Henry on X, formerly Twitter. Another added he was “behaving like a right plum.” A range of fans described the ceremony as “awkward”.
